# EventWave Event / Venue Promotion

Capability ID: eventwave-paid-promotion-v1
Commercial state: migration_hold
Machine state: owned_runtime_migration_pending
Public URL: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/capabilities/eventwave-paid-promotion-v1
Preferred agent route: universal fallback
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp
Start here: Not a current sell-now route

## Use this when

- promote my event on EventWave
- promote my local event
- help people find my event
- advertise my event
- promote an event
- boost event visibility
- boost this event
- feature my venue on EventWave
- promote my venue
- buy event promotion
- promote this venue's events

## Problem

An organizer or venue wants a bounded paid EventWave placement with verified payment, source review and controlled activation.

## Inputs

Choose Event Boost or Venue Pack, provide contact email and the relevant public event or venue identifiers/URL.

## Outputs

Verified order state, source-review state, bounded activated placement, placement expiry and activation evidence.

## Pricing

Event Boost $49 one-time; Venue Pack $149 one-time.

- Event Boost: $49 (one_time)

- Venue Pack: $149 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.

Explicit purchase confirmation and verified payment are required. Source review must pass before any public placement activates.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
